pixel_file_encoding: RGB24: three bytes R,G,B per row-major pixel; JSON packed hex is 0x00RRGGBB
method: Standalone integer/Fraction arithmetic over supplied literal coverage; no renderer, planner, fonts or engine imported/executed.
alpha_rule: a=floor(color_alpha*coverage/255); channel=floor((src*a+dst*(255-a)+127)/255), independently for every ordered draw
coordinate_rule: Glyph row origins and y absolute signed i32; never offset again. Current clip applies at integer pixel origins with exclusive upper edges.

pixel_cases.name: coverage-alpha-floor
pixel_cases.claim: Coverage alpha truncates before each independently rounded channel blend.

pixel_cases.name: repeated-low-alpha
pixel_cases.claim: Eight individually rounded alpha-one operations; final 0x080808.

pixel_cases.name: signed-row-origins-and-y
pixel_cases.claim: Negative y clips the first mask row, without advancing or flattening row origins.

pixel_cases.name: fractional-clip-both-edges
pixel_cases.claim: Only integer origins x=1,2,3 and y=1 satisfy the fractional clip; y=2 is excluded.

pixel_cases.name: fixed-escape-and-restoration
pixel_cases.claim: Glyph positions are absolute even inside Fixed. Fixed escapes inner clip and Pop restores it; final PopClip restores caller clip.

pixel_cases.name: empty-zero-coverage-and-alpha
pixel_cases.claim: Canonical empty has no dispatch; nonempty zero coverage still dispatches; alpha zero/empty clip omit only after validation.

pixel_cases.name: signed-i32-extremes
pixel_cases.claim: Only the final row of first operation is visible; signed origin/extent arithmetic must not wrap.

pixel_cases.name: dispatch-tail-9x9
pixel_cases.claim: Partial 8x8 workgroups must not write beyond the target or source.

refusal_cases.name: source-index

refusal_cases.name: row-index
refusal_cases.reason: Row-table-only index is outside the single table.

refusal_cases.name: row-height
refusal_cases.reason: Reached row table length must equal mask height.

refusal_cases.name: noncanonical-empty-1
refusal_cases.reason: Only 0x0 with empty coverage is valid empty.

refusal_cases.name: coverage-length

refusal_cases.reason: One mask axis exceeds 1024 even unused.

refusal_cases.name: aggregate-coverage
refusal_cases.reason: Valid individual shapes total 262145 coverage bytes.

refusal_cases.name: combined-sources
refusal_cases.reason: Image and mask sources together total 257.

refusal_cases.name: row-table-count
refusal_cases.reason: 257 supplied empty tables exceed table count.

refusal_cases.name: aggregate-rows
refusal_cases.reason: 65 tables individually fit but total 65537 entries.

refusal_cases.name: command-count
refusal_cases.reason: Transparent empty glyph operations still count before omission.

refusal_cases.name: scope-depth
refusal_cases.reason: Balanced nesting depth 33 exceeds 32 independently of op count.

refusal_cases.name: gpu-buffer-cap
refusal_cases.reason: Visible glyph packs all coverage as u32: 1048576 coverage + 2048 rows + 512 uniforms + 8 target/readback = 1051144 > 1048576. No images/LUTs.

refusal_cases.name: invocation-cap
refusal_cases.reason: Unconditional clear plus 52 full-frame glyph draws: 53*76800 = 4070400 > 4000000. Explicit bytes 614400+307200+960+53*256=936128 stay below cap.

refusal_cases.name: target-high-byte
refusal_cases.reason: Packed target clear must be 0x00RRGGBB, independent of text alpha.
